title: Marabou retail engagement notebook
content:
Quick brain-dump for Marabou (mid-market omni-channel retailer) — working notes, outreach drafts, and a lightweight pilot proposal. Mostly for my own flow; will refine before sharing with Jordan/Priya.

Account snapshot
- Company: Marabou Retail (approx $250M ARR). HQ: Minneapolis. 600 employees.
- Current signals: posted roles for Head of Personalization & Senior ML infra engineer (Jan 2025). Recently announced a marketplace initiative + mobile checkout push.
- Tech stack clues: Snowflake + BigQuery mentions in job posts, uses Contentful for CMS, experiments with Pinecone for product search (single contributor notes on GH).
- Primary pain: search relevance and conversion on mobile, high call center volume for returns/exchanges, and recommendation freshness.
- Security/compliance: PCI obviously, they call out SOC2 in vendor checklist. Likely will prefer Private or Dedicated for PII-sensitive flows.

Buyer map (probable):
- Primary: Head of Personalization (buyer, cares ROI, conversion uplift).
- Technical champion: Senior ML infra / ML Eng lead (evaluates latency, throughput, model ops).
- Procurement / Legal: Vendor risk & SOC2 / DPA.
- Product manager for mobile: cares about UX, latency perceived by end-user.

Hypothesis for value prop
- Use Redwood to improve mobile search + conversational product finder with 80–150ms p99 inference for short queries -> measurable lift in add-to-cart and NPS for discovery flows.
- Offload experimentation: Redwood rollouts/canary -> iterate models without heavy infra. Lower TCO vs. building internal serving.
- For contact-center rerank / triage: embeddings for semantic search + reranking reduces average handle time and transfers.

Potential pilot scope (6–8 weeks)
- Phase 0 (1 week): data touchpoint mapping, narrow test cases (mobile search autocomplete + 1 vertical: womens footwear). Obtain sample queries, product catalog snapshot, SSO for logs.
- Phase 1 (2–3 weeks): small model A/B on hosted Redwood API, integration via a proxy to product search API. Measure CTR -> CR on flagged queries.
- Phase 2 (2 weeks): move to Dedicated or Private (if they require SOC2), deploy quantized model variant and enable prefix caching for repeat queries.
- Phase 3 (1 week): wrap-up, handoff docs + runbook, performance & cost report, rollout recommendation.

Key metrics to propose
- Primary: add-to-cart lift on test queries (+% vs control).
- Secondary: p50/p95 inference latency, infra cost per 1000 queries, call center triage Reduction in AHT.

Objections I expect + short scripts
- "We already have vector search (Pinecone) and in-house models."
  - Quick reply: super — Redwood is complementary. We can serve model variants and provide low-friction A/B and latency guarantees; many customers keep their vector store and use Redwood for model runtime + rollouts. Offer a small integration that uses their Pinecone for embeddings and Redwood for reranking.
- "Security / SOC2 / PII concerns"
  - Reply: acknowledge. Offer Dedicated capacity for data isolation or Private deployment (VPC) for stricter control; highlight KMS/HSM options and audit logs. Propose an NDA + initial data security questionnaire fill to move forward.
- "Cost — building in-house is cheaper long-term"
  - Reply: short-term time-to-value & reduced maintenance risk offsets initial spend; propose a narrow pilot with clear success metrics and a cost forecast showing time-to-payback. Reference case: XX% reduce infra ops headcount/time (placeholder to replace with real case study).
- "Latency unpredictable with third-party API"
  - Reply: Redwood Dedicated provides predictability & p99 SLOs. For strict latency needs we can suggest edge routing + region pinning.

Outbound sequence (first draft)
- Subject line A: Quick idea to reduce mobile search drop-off at Marabou
- Subject line B: 30-minute pilot to test a model-driven product finder?
- Email 1 (cold):
  Hi <Name> — I’m Asha from Redwood Inference (we help product teams ship low-latency model-powered search & recommendations). I noticed Marabou recently listed roles for personalization and you’ve been testing vector search.

  If you’re open, I’d like to propose a short pilot: a targeted A/B that serves a model-driven autocomplete/rerank for one product vertical and measures add-to-cart lift. No infra changes required for the trial.

  Would you be open to a 20–30 minute sync next week to scope?

  — Asha

- Email 2 (followup):
  Quick follow on my note — happy to share a one-page pilot scope + cost estimate. Also attaching 2 screenshots of a similar experiment we ran (anonymized) that showed +12% CTR on targeted queries.

- Call script bullets (10–15 min intro)
  - 1 min: quick intro + one-liner value prop
  - 2 min: confirm top priority (search vs recommendations vs contact center)
  - 4 min: propose pilot scope (see above) and timeline
  - 4 min: surface security/ops needs (SOC2, region, data residency)
  - close: ask to introduce technical champion and schedule pilot kickoff

Integration notes (tech to prep)
- We’ll want: sample query logs (last 30 days), product catalog dump (CSV), current search infra endpoints, and a lightweight proxy or test harness for A/B.
- Data privacy: scrub PII; we can run with hashed identifiers.
- Performance: expect to test p99 under their query distribution — collect baseline percentiles so we can size Dedicated pool if needed.

Pricing sketch to start conversation (ballpark, narrow):
- Pilot (4–8 weeks): flat $12k–18k (cover hosted usage, engineering time, 1 model variant).
- If Dedicated required: add monthly reserved capacity (quote after we profile).
- Note: these numbers are for conversation only; final will depend on qps/seq length.

Notes to self / next steps
- Find a contact: LinkedIn leads: "Mallory Jensen" (Head of Personalization) — try warm intro via Jordan.
- Draft a short one-pager with pilot scope + sample metrics (deliverable for email followup). Assign to Priya to create the visuals.
- Prepare an anonymized case study extract I can paste into emails: need conversion delta + latency/cost numbers (ask Solutions Eng for 1 pager).
- Check SOC2 paperwork template + Private deployment checklist with Legal.

Open questions / unknowns
- What is Marabou’s current query volume distribution (mobile vs desktop)? Need to quantify to pick Dedicated sizing.
- Are they already hosting models low-latency (e.g., on-device or in-house GPU)?
- Who owns vendor sign-off for infra purchases? Procurement vs IT?

Rough timeline for follow-up (my calendar)
- 2025-02-19: draft one-pager ready
- 2025-02-20: outreach to Mallory via LinkedIn + email
- 2025-02-24: if no response, call center outreach + send pilot summary to procurement

Random scratch thoughts
- Could position an initial pilot as a "reduce return friction" experiment (use LLM to generate suggested return explanations + auto-fill return forms) — might get traction with ops/product.
- If they push back on cost, propose a risk-share model: lower upfront + success fee based on conversion improvement.
